actions.reason: The K6_C0001-K6_C0004 boundary is the weakest and most merge-compatible of the decision-relevant neighbors: boundary representation is conflicting with three of four native geometries (CT, RNA, WSI) showing negligible separation and only WXS moderate (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:943649b4c5), and the structural diagnostics show high normalized-cut cost (0.720) indicating substantial cross-boundary connectivity with a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.637), which is merge-compatible and not boundary support (ER:...structural_diagnostics:pair:943649b4c5). Biologically, K6_C0001 (PBRM1-enriched) and K6_C0004 (no surviving driver-panel enrichment, VHL/PBRM1 near partition background) do not present a clear independent distinction that would oppose union (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:b8656a7616, ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:2575ce42e3). The union is therefore more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained sets.

actions.reason: The exact-pair structural diagnostics for K6_C0002|K6_C0003 show a conflicting pattern: the current boundary is represented (two-way spectral ARI ~0.89, between-side affinity ~0.217 vs within-side ~0.434) but the normalized-cut cost is high (~0.690), reflecting substantial cross-boundary connectivity, and the union eigengap shows candidate_k=1 with a dominant leading gap (0.600), i.e. the union is dominated by the single-cluster resolution. The pair affinity geometry concordance shows only weak within-versus-between distinction (silhouettes 0.049-0.141) with negative fractions up to 0.389. The high cross-boundary connectivity and single-cluster-dominated union make the union more consistent with a single unit than with two independently retained units, so the provisional merge of K6_C0002 and K6_C0003 is supported.

actions.reason: Interpretable PBRM1/VHL mutation phenotype (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:68d14ecb60) is not matched by membership support: set-level geometry is weak and conflicting with CT actively negative (-0.064, 97% misaligned) and RNA near zero (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:68d14ecb60), and the pair boundary with K6_C0002_M_K6_C0003 is only weakly expressed across modalities (silhouettes 0.039-0.115, negative fractions 0.21-0.35) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:75a6315896). Pervasive technical/acquisition imbalance (site, CT phase, manufacturer, scanner, kernel, slice thickness, z-spacing, q<0.05) remains a plausible alternative explanation for membership (ER:...confounder_association:set:68d14ecb60). With broadly unsupported membership, weak boundaries, and no supported split or merge alternative, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

Coherent oxidative-phosphorylation/fatty-acid/mTORC1 transcriptomic identity (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:16b15f8341) is not matched by membership support: three of four modalities show negative silhouettes with high misalignment (RNA -0.088, WSI -0.036, WXS -0.106) and nearest competitors differ by modality (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:16b15f8341). The boundary to K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 is only weakly expressed (silhouettes 0.039-0.115) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:75a6315896) and the boundary to K6_C0005 is weak-to-modest (0.020-0.154) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:a1628e868f). Strong pervasive technical imbalance (site Cramer's V 0.56, slice thickness/z-spacing epsilon-squared ~0.30) remains a plausible alternative explanation (ER:...confounder_association:set:16b15f8341). No supported split or merge alternative; candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

Interpretable BAP1 mutation phenotype (OR 23.06, q_global=0.018) (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:1127836987) is not matched by membership support: RNA is positive (0.147) but WSI (-0.076) and WXS (-0.078) are negative with high misalignment, and nearest competitors differ by modality (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:1127836987). The boundary to K6_C0002_M_K6_C0003 is weak-to-modest (0.020-0.154) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:a1628e868f) and the boundary to K6_C0006 shows material cross-modal disagreement (strong WXS 0.432 vs weak CT/WSI) (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:1b1d5e2110). Site and slice/z-spacing imbalance remain plausible alternative explanations (ER:...confounder_association:set:1127836987). No supported split or merge alternative; candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

Coherent EMT/Hedgehog/angiogenesis transcriptomic identity (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:b7ae245f3f) is not matched by membership support: CT (-0.057), RNA (-0.054), and WSI (-0.079) all show negative silhouettes with high misalignment (0.71-0.79), while WXS is an extreme outlier (1.0), indicating material cross-modal disagreement (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:b7ae245f3f). The boundary to K6_C0005 shows strong WXS but weak CT/WSI separation (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:1b1d5e2110). Although no technical factor reached significance, nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding and the small set (n=14) limits power (ER:...confounder_association:set:b7ae245f3f). No supported split or merge alternative; candidate lacks defensible discovery value.
